title: Testing OpenFeature-backed flags: use setTestFlags, not config.featureToggles
answers: How do I set a feature flag value in a test after migrating it to OpenFeature?
My test mutates config.featureToggles but the flag isn't picked up by the component
How to reset feature flags between tests?
body: Fix pattern: once a flag is consumed via `useFlagX()`/`getFeatureFlagClient()`, tests must set it with `setTestFlags({ [FlagKeys.X]: true })` from '@grafana/test-utils/unstable' (key from `FlagKeys` in '@grafana/runtime/internal'), not by assigning `config.featureToggles.<name>` directly — the OpenFeature client no longer reads that config path. Constraint: call `setTestFlags()` with no args in `afterEach` to reset flag state between tests, otherwise flags leak across test cases.
applies: Jest tests for components/hooks that read flags via getFeatureFlagClient or useFlag* hooks
says: Feature flag value not applying in my test after migration
How do I enable an experimental feature for this specific test?
Feature toggle resets between tests unexpectedly
Component ignores the toggle value I set in test config
Setting feature flags for OpenFeature without hardcoded strings
search: Testing OpenFeature-backed feature flags requires calling setTestFlags({ [FlagKeys.X]: true }) from '@grafana/test-utils/unstable' instead of assigning config.featureToggles directly, because the OpenFeature client no longer reads that config path. The FlagKeys enum is imported from '@grafana/runtime/internal' and applies to components/hooks consuming flags via useFlagX() or getFeatureFlagClient() calls. In afterEach cleanup, call setTestFlags() with no arguments to reset flag state between tests; omitting this causes flags to leak across test cases. See public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/VizPanelSubHeader.test.tsx for pattern examples.
